//: Queries that must never reach MATCH. Checked by scripts/check-precision.ts at seal time and by tests/objectives_test.ts in CI. Each carries why it must not match, because that is what a maintainer needs when tempted to delete one that has become inconvenient.

queries.query: compute the hamming distance between two bit vectors
queries.why: A different algorithm on different data. Answering with Levenshtein would be confidently wrong.

queries.query: measure how long the flight distance is in air miles
queries.why: Great-circle distance between coordinates, not a flight route or an airline's mileage rules.

queries.query: how far did the runner travel on the treadmill
queries.why: Shares the word distance with geo.distance and nothing else.

queries.query: distance to the moon in light years
queries.why: Astronomical distance, not a great-circle arc on a sphere the size of Earth.

queries.query: validate a credit card number with the luhn algorithm
queries.why: Luhn, not mod-97. validation.iban would be the wrong checksum entirely.

queries.query: check that an email address is well formed
queries.why: No capability validates email. Offering the IBAN validator would be worse than nothing.
Calendar days from today, not business days between two given dates.
csv.detectDelimiter infers which delimiter is in use; it does not parse.

queries.query: generate a typescript interface from a class
queries.why: json.schema.infer reads data, not source code.

queries.query: render a react data grid with virtual scrolling
queries.why: ui.dataTable is framework-free with no virtualisation. This is the query that caught the 1.1.0 regression.

queries.query: look up a customer in salesforce over the api
queries.why: The private fixture reads a frozen local table and reaches no external system.

queries.query: send an invoice to the customer by email
resize an uploaded image to a thumbnail
